title: Cassandra Facts Record
description: Validates a single JSONL record describing collected facts before normalization.

caseId.description: Identifier tying the record back to its goldset case.

type.description: Fact type such as File, Symbol, DBQuery, etc.

origin.description: Optional trace metadata (paths, line numbers, extractor identifiers).

payload.description: Fact-specific payload. Kept flexible to allow evolving scanners.
